_comment: Safety net, lowest priority. routes/api.php has far more route groups than the five tiers above enumerate individually (stories, wallet, gifts, verification, screen-time, devices, location, music/audio, two-factor, account, profile, suggestions, history, device-scoped realtime state, etc.) - without this, anything not explicitly tiered would 404 at the gateway, which would be a real functionality regression. This catches everything else under /api/v1/*, plus the framework health check (/up) and Sanctum's CSRF-cookie route, at a default rate limit matching Laravel's own existing global throttle:api (300/min) for parity - so nothing here is any stricter than what the app already enforces itself.
name: teezer-catchall
desc: Default tier for every /api/v1/* route not explicitly tiered above

limit-count.rejected_msg: Too many requests. Please slow down and try again shortly.
